sentences.english: It is Monday morning.

sentences.text: Sam y Nico caminan a la escuela.
sentences.english: Sam and Nico walk to school.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sam, ¿qué hiciste el fin de semana?
sentences.english: Sam, what did you do over the weekend?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Fue un fin de semana muy bueno.
sentences.english: It was a very good weekend.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: The day before yesterday we went to a party.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: A party?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Where?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: En la casa de un vecino.
sentences.english: At a neighbor's house.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Es la casa de Kevin, un cipote de ocho años.
sentences.english: It is the house of Kevin, a boy of eight.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: And what did you do?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Look, I will tell you everything.
The day before yesterday was Saturday.

sentences.text: Doña Marta y Ana cocinaron en la casa.
sentences.english: Doña Marta and Ana cooked at the house.

sentences.text: Doña Marta cocinó pollo y frijoles para la comida de la tarde.
sentences.english: Doña Marta cooked chicken and beans for the afternoon meal.
I helped with the bread.

sentences.text: Caminé a la pulpería y compré café.
sentences.english: I walked to the shop and bought coffee.
Nico did not help.
He played with his small game.

sentences.text: Ana compró pan y puso el pan en la mesa.
sentences.english: Ana bought bread and put the bread on the table.

sentences.text: Yo compré un libro para Kevin.
sentences.english: I bought a book for Kevin.
It was my present.

sentences.text: Anteayer hizo calor y hizo sol.
sentences.english: The day before yesterday it was hot and sunny.

sentences.text: En la casa de Kevin conocí a mucha gente nueva.
sentences.english: At Kevin's house I met many new people.

sentences.text: Daniel, el papá de Kevin, me dijo:
sentences.english: Daniel, Kevin's father, said to me:

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Thank you for the present, Sam.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: You are welcome.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is Kevin going to read the book?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Of course.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Kevin reads a lot.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Hoy tiene otro regalo de su familia.
sentences.english: Today he has another present from his family.

sentences.text: Después de comer, la gente bailó.
sentences.english: After eating, the people danced.
Ana danced with Luis.
I danced for a moment.

sentences.text: Nico trajo su juego, pero jugó solo.
sentences.english: Nico brought his game, but he played alone.

sentences.text: Daniel cocinó tamales y sopa para toda la gente.
sentences.english: Daniel cooked tamales and soup for all the people.
I felt very happy.

sentences.text: Quizás es la gente, quizás es la comida.
sentences.english: Maybe it is the people, maybe it is the food.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: It is already eight.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Shall we go back?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: One moment, Luis.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I cannot right now.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: We will go back later.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Before nine.
We spent a very good day.

sentences.text: Anoche dormí poco, pero estoy bien.
sentences.english: Last night I slept little, but I am fine.

sentences.text: El domingo dimos un paseo por el parque.
sentences.english: On Sunday we took a walk in the park.

sentences.text: Fuimos Ana, Luis, Nico y yo.
sentences.english: Ana, Luis, Nico and I went.

sentences.text: No es verano, pero hizo calor.
sentences.english: It is not summer, but it was hot.

sentences.text: En este mes hay lluvia, pero el domingo hizo sol.
sentences.english: In this month there is rain, but on Sunday it was sunny.
There are many people there.
I looked at the people.

sentences.text: Vi a Kevin con su papá.
sentences.english: I saw Kevin with his father.
Nico asked for water.
Luis put the bag here.

sentences.text: Un señor vendió plátanos y compré uno para Nico.
sentences.english: A man sold plantains and I bought one for Nico.

sentences.text: Me quedé allí un momento con Nico.
sentences.english: I stayed there for a moment with Nico.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Is it possible to play here?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Of course, Nico.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: But is it safe?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: It is safe.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Es un lugar bueno, y hay mucha gente.
sentences.english: It is a good place, and there are many people.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Can I play alone?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: No, it is not possible.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: It is better to play with us.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: All right.
It was a very good walk.

sentences.text: El paseo terminó a las cinco.
sentences.english: The walk ended at five.
That is how we spent Sunday.
Then we went back to the house.
We had time and we all cooked.

sentences.text: Luis es maestro, y hoy habla con Sam y con Nico.
sentences.english: Luis is a teacher, and today he talks with Sam and with Nico.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Sam, ¿vas a escribir sobre tu fin de semana?
sentences.english: Sam, are you going to write about your weekend?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Yes, I am going to write.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Estoy seguro de que tengo mucho que escribir.
sentences.english: I am sure I have a lot to write.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sam, ¿puedo ir a otra fiesta con vos?
sentences.english: Sam, can I go to another party with you?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Of course, Nico.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: It is possible.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Maybe in the summer.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Good.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Everyone has to write today.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: I will write too, Luis.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: I am writing about the park.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Very good.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: We write and afterwards we talk.
